name: Shri Datta Mandir, Narsobawadi
summary: Narsobawadi — major Datta peetha on the Maharashtra Datta yatra.
mythology: Dattatreya — the three-headed Guru of the Trimurti — is worshipped here as living guide. Datta Jayanti and Thursday seva draw devotees seeking Guru-kripa along the Krishna.
bestTime: October–March for most plains sites; confirm Himalayan seasonal windows separately.
